newsitem.title: GERMANY: Jungheinrich sees 35 mln DM 97 profit.
newsitem.headline: Jungheinrich sees 35 mln DM 97 profit.

text.p: German forklift maker Jungheinrich AG said on Tuesday it had returned to profit in the first half of 1996, and expected to see a 35 million mark net profit for the full year.
In the first half, the group posted a net profit of 17.3 million marks, swinging from a loss of 7.2 million in the year-earlier half, mainly due to one-off costs for personnel reductions.
The full-year profit forecast is up from the company's outlook for a 30 billion mark profit released with five-month results in June.
Sales in the first half were up five percent to 1.216 billion marks.
In 1996, the company lost 20 million marks on sales of 2.4 billion marks.
